samples.label: Basic usage
samples.description: Lines, a count and the three selectors of SkeletonLoaderComponent, with a custom loading text and label. The first run downloads Angular (about 1 MB).

samples.label: Appearances and animations
samples.description: Switch the appearance (line, circle, square), the animation (progress, pulse, their dark variants or none), the count and the size of circles and squares at runtime.

samples.label: Theming
samples.description: Restyle the placeholders with --ngx-skeleton-loader-* CSS variables (preview colors, a custom palette, line height, radius and duration) and the theme input, merged over a provider theme with extendsFromRoot.

samples.label: Loading states
samples.description: Simulated requests swap skeletons and content with @if, a custom-content card placeholder, and application defaults set once with provideSkeletonLoader.
